solution.name: Copilot Studio Agent - Agents SDK web part

shortDescription.default: Embed authenticated Copilot Studio agents on any SharePoint site through the Microsoft 365 Agents SDK.

longDescription.default: Adds the 'Copilot Studio Agent (Agents SDK)' web part. It signs the current user in silently with Microsoft Entra ID (MSAL, SPA app registration with Power Platform API / CopilotStudio.Copilots.Invoke) and talks to the agent through @microsoft/agents-copilotstudio-client rendered with Bot Framework Web Chat. Configure each instance with the agent's Agents SDK connection string.

features.title: Copilot Studio Agent - Agents SDK web part
features.description: Deploys the Copilot Studio Agent (Agents SDK) web part.
